scope: The one exact Zabbix 7.0 LTS patch that the disposable reference lab, the deployment-path lab and their validators target (R27). Earlier records at 7.0.0 and 7.0.10 keep their own bindings and are not rewritten.

selected.tag_commit_source: git ls-remote https://github.com/zabbix/zabbix refs/tags/7.0.31 on 2026-09-22 (official mirror)
selected.release_candidate: 7.0.31rc1 (2026-09-15) was released as 7.0.31 without any changes (ChangeLog at the tag)

fallback.rule: Only if the Ubuntu 24.04 package index does not list 7.0.31. A substitution is a new pin recorded here and in the amendment; never mix package versions.

verified_from_source.note: Read from raw.githubusercontent.com/zabbix/zabbix/7.0.31 on 2026-09-22; zabbix.com, repo.zabbix.com and the GitHub archive endpoint were not reachable from the preparing environment.

include/zbx_dbversion_constants.h.note: 18.x support entered the 7.0 line in 7.0.20 (ChangeLog ZBXNEXT-10219, 7.0.20rc1)

conf/zabbix_server.conf.lab_rule: keep the default so PostgreSQL 18 is supported, not merely allowed

ubuntu_packages.status: NOT_VERIFIED_FROM_THE_PREPARING_ENVIRONMENT: repo.zabbix.com was blocked; the runner host must pass the verification gate before this pin is treated as an installed identity

expected_signing_key.note: the April 2024 key; confirm the fingerprint from the installed keyring before trusting the index

ubuntu_packages.expected_version_string: 1:7.0.31-1+ubuntu24.04 (inferred from the 7.0.24 and 7.0.29 patterns; the Debian revision is unconfirmed)
verification_gate: apt-cache madison zabbix-server-pgsql zabbix-frontend-php zabbix-sql-scripts lists exactly the pinned version from repo.zabbix.com
dpkg-query -W -f '${Package}\t${Version}\t${Architecture}\n' for every package above matches the pin, and lab/zabbix_native_lab.py status records them

postgresql.package: postgresql-18 from PGDG noble-pgdg (Ubuntu's archive stops at 16)

dependencies.web: official packages pair nginx + php8.3-fpm (zabbix-nginx-conf) or Apache; the disposable lab serves the packaged frontend files from a private copy with the PHP built-in server on 127.0.0.1:58080, which is a loopback lab convenience and not an official deployment configuration

lab_relevant_changes_since_7_0_10: 7.0.20 ZBXNEXT-10219: PostgreSQL 18 becomes a supported database version
7.0.25 ZBX-26128: acknowledgements with equal timestamps are ordered by id
7.0.26/7.0.30 ZBX-27485, ZBX-27836: user-role edit form fixes (frontend only)
7.0.28 ZBX-27561: fewer errors when parallel API requests edit user or host groups
trapper history.push memory-leak fix (DEV-4909, 2026-04-21) in 7.0.26 and later
token, role and history API classes have no functional change since January 2025
